questions.stem: According to the passage, who serves as plant-trial judges for All-America Selections each year?
options: More than 80 horticultural professionals from the U.S. and Canada
Only professional gardeners from Canada
A small group of seed company executives
University students studying botany
questions.evidence: Each year, the independent, nonprofit organization All-America Selections (AAS) enlists more than 80 horticultural professionals from around the United States and Canada to serve as plant-trial judges.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에 AAS가 미국과 캐나다의 80명 이상의 원예 전문가를 심사위원으로 활용한다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, all of the following were praised by judges EXCEPT which?
options: Celosia Flamma Pink's performance in hot and humid weather
Vinca Sphere Polkadot's resistance to disease and heavy rain
Marigold Mango Tango's poor color retention over time
Petunia Dekko Maxx Pink's ability to hold up against heavy rain
questions.evidence: The small, strong plants provide nonstop color over an extended season.
questions.explanation_ko: Marigold Mango Tango는 오랜 기간 지속적인 색상을 제공한다고 칭찬받았으므로 '색상 유지가 나쁘다'는 사실과 반대입니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about why AAS conducts trials with judges across different regions?
options: To ensure plants can be tested under a variety of climate conditions
Because seed companies require judges to be spread out
To reduce the cost of growing plants
Because only certain regions allow flower gardening
questions.evidence: Judges praised its good performance even in hot and humid weather.
questions.explanation_ko: 다양한 지역의 심사위원이 참여한다는 것은 여러 기후 조건에서 식물의 성능을 시험하기 위함임을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author include the definition of "succession sowing" in the paragraph about Zinnia Crestar Mix?
options: To explain a gardening term that helps readers understand the plant's benefit of continuous blooming
To criticize the practice as too complicated for beginners
To compare it unfavorably with other zinnia varieties
To introduce an unrelated gardening technique
questions.evidence: Succession sowing means growing several plants that bloom in different seasons in your garden.
questions.explanation_ko: 저자는 독자가 이해하기 어려울 수 있는 전문 용어를 설명하여 이 식물이 계속해서 꽃을 피우는 이점을 이해하도록 돕고 있습니다.

questions.stem: In the sentence "This dianthus was bred by Selecta One," what does "bred" mean in this context?
options: Caused a plant to reproduce with desired qualities through controlled methods
Purchased from a store
Discovered growing wild in nature
Painted with artificial colors
questions.evidence: This dianthus was bred by Selecta One.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문 마지막 어휘 설명에 따르면 'breed'는 원하는 특성을 가진 자손을 얻기 위해 식물을 통제된 방식으로 번식시키는 것을 의미합니다.

blanks.sentence_ko: 자연스럽게 촘촘하게 모여 둥근 모양을 이루며, 이 식물은 여름 내내 꽃을 피웁니다.

blanks.expression: nonstop color over an extended season
blanks.sentence_ko: 작고 튼튼한 이 식물들은 긴 기간 동안 끊임없는 색상을 제공합니다.
꽃들은 계절 내내 식물을 뒤덮었고 강한 비와 나쁜 날씨에도 잘 견뎠습니다.
질병 저항성이 있는 이 식물은 전반적인 내구성으로 심사위원들에게 깊은 인상을 주었습니다.

key_points: All-America Selections (AAS) uses over 80 horticultural judges across the U.S. and Canada to trial new plants each year.
Several new flowering plant varieties were tested and praised for qualities like heat and humidity tolerance, disease resistance, and durability against weather.
Examples include Celosia Flamma Pink, Vinca Sphere Polkadot, Zinnia Crestar Mix, Dahlia Black Forest Ruby, and several others bred by different companies.
Some plants, like Marigold Mango Tango and the Nasturtium varieties, were specifically praised by European judges.
The purpose of the article is to give gardeners ideas for new flowering plants to try in their gardens.
main_idea: The passage introduces a variety of newly developed flowering plants that were tested and praised by horticultural judges through the All-America Selections trial program, offering gardeners new options to try.
restate_sentence: Each year, the independent, nonprofit organization All-America Selections (AAS) enlists more than 80 horticultural professionals from around the United States and Canada to serve as plant-trial judges.
